visual_observations: Recognizable adult A1 face, silver-gray grouped long hair, original ring clip, gray-blue eyes, studs, calm expression, low hands and slight weight shift closely match the source.
Entire head, both hands and both pumps remain inside frame with clear margins.
Ivory fitted wrap dress, ink-teal side panels, mandarin collar, diagonal knotted closure and smoky-blue short shoulder drape read clearly as contemporary Chinese-inspired fashion.
Opaque inner skirt layer, waist shaping, hosiery and pumps are coherent; background remains quiet and source-like.
deviations: Cloud motif is a broader graphic hem pattern rather than one fine seam motif.
There are more than two knotted closure details and added small tassels on the shoulder drape and waist.
Pumps use a modest mid-height block heel rather than a particularly low one.
